name: 直向分隔線左右分區＋橫向連結列＋置中底部列
desc: 上半部用一條直向分隔線分成左側品牌區與右側數欄文字連結，下方以橫跨畫面的分隔線隔出一列橫向文字連結與置中的底部列。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。上半部左右分成兩區，中間以一條直向分隔線隔開，分隔線上端貼齊頁尾上緣、向下延伸到下方的橫向分隔線：左側約七成是品牌區，靠左、靠上放標誌，下方可放多行次要資訊文字，沒有時省略，其餘留大片空白；右側約三成放數欄直向排列的文字連結，沒有小標題，頂端和標誌大致對齊；右區很窄，欄數少，連結不多時只排兩欄，各欄長度可不同。右區最下方、貼近上半部下緣（直向分隔線的下端）可放一個小型文字連結，和上方連結之間隔著大片空白，沒有時省略。上半部的上方留白明顯大於一般。上半部下方有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線，接著是一列靠左、橫向排列的文字連結，每個連結旁帶一個小箭頭圖示；最後一個連結之後緊接著可放一個小圖示連結，同樣靠左、不推到右端，沒有時省略。這一列很矮，高度約只有一行連結，上下只留少許空白。最下方是底部列，上方再有一條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線：一行小字水平置中。
mobile: 隱藏右區的文字連結與其下方的小型文字連結，直向分隔線一併取消；品牌區與次要資訊文字靠左放在最上方。兩條橫跨畫面寬的分隔線保留；橫向文字連結列仍維持一列並排，連結文字可換行，小圖示連結在最右側；底部列的一行小字仍水平置中。高度依內容而定，沒有動態。

en.name: Split by a vertical divider + horizontal link row + centered bottom bar
en.desc: The upper part is split by a vertical divider into a brand block on the left and multi-column text links on the right; below, full-width dividers separate a row of horizontal text links and a centered bottom bar.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. The upper part is split into left and right areas separated by a vertical divider; the divider's top end is flush with the top edge of the footer and it extends down to the horizontal divider below. The left area, about seventy percent, is the brand block: a logo placed at the top left, and optionally multi-line secondary text below it, omitted when there is no content; the rest is left as a large empty space. The right area, about thirty percent, holds several columns of vertically stacked text links with no group headings, their tops roughly aligned with the logo; the right area is narrow, so it holds only a few columns, just two when there are few links, and the columns may differ in length. Optionally place one small text link at the very bottom of the right area, close to the bottom edge of the upper part (the lower end of the vertical divider), separated from the links above by a large empty space; omit it when there is no content. The space above the upper part is noticeably larger than usual. Below the upper part is a divider spanning the full viewport width, followed by a left-aligned row of horizontally arranged text links, each with a small arrow icon beside it; optionally place one small icon link immediately after the last link, also left-aligned and not pushed to the right end, omitted when there is no content. This row is very short, roughly the height of a single line of links, with only a little space above and below. At the very bottom is the bottom bar, with another divider spanning the full viewport width above it: a line of small text, horizontally centered.
en.mobile: Hide the text links in the right area and the small text link below them, and remove the vertical divider as well; the brand block and secondary text sit left-aligned at the top. Both full-viewport-width dividers remain; the horizontal text link row stays in a single row with link text allowed to wrap, and the small icon link sits at the far right; the line of small text in the bottom bar stays horizontally centered. The height is determined by its content, with no motion.
